instruction: Search for Apply to each and select it. Click into Select an output from previous steps, open the dynamic content picker and select Attachments.
title: Animation: select Apply to each, open the lightning bolt picker and choose Attachments
intro: Press Play to watch steps 2 and 3: Apply to each, the lightning bolt, then Attachments.

steps.caption: With Apply to each typed in the search box, select Apply to each under Control.
The loop's settings open on the left. Click into Select an output from previous steps, then select the lightning bolt beside it.
The loop's settings open on the left. Click into Select an output from previous steps, then select the lightning bolt beside it.
Under When a new email arrives (V3), select Attachments.
Attachments is now in the box. The loop runs once for every attachment in the email.
